Jiang suggests possible orientation errors based on two versus36directions. This is primary experimental criticism, not a demonstrated correction or measurement of Conrad uncertainty.
All three selected literal Cij-derived KS remain in every error case. Density/rounding controls are distinctly calculated reductions, not new observations.
